function first<T>(value:ArrayLike<T>):T {return value[0];}
first({0:'hi',length:1}).toFixed();
Array.from({0:3,length:1},value=>value.toUpperCase());
first({length:1}).toFixed();
const mixed = Array.from({0:3,1:'hi',length:2});
mixed[0].toFixed();
first(3);
interface MissingIndex {0:number;length:number}
const invalid:MissingIndex={0:3,length:1};
first(invalid);
